title.zh: 将拉乌尼翁省Agoo市镇现有的Baybay小学正式更名为San Manuel Sur小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Baybay Elementary School in Barangay San Manuel Sur, Municipality of Agoo, Province of La Union to San Manuel Sur Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Baybay Elementary School in Barangay San Manuel Sur, Municipality of Agoo, Province of La Union to San Manuel Sur Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Baybay tại Barangay San Manuel Sur, Thị trấn Agoo, Tỉnh La Union thành Trường tiểu học San Manuel Sur
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Baybay ในบารังไกย์ San Manuel Sur, เทศบาล Agoo, จังหวัด La Union เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา San Manuel Sur
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Baybay di Barangay San Manuel Sur, Kotamadya Agoo, Provinsi La Union menjadi Sekolah Dasar San Manuel Sur
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Baybay di Barangay San Manuel Sur, Perbandaran Agoo, Wilayah La Union menjadi Sekolah Rendah San Manuel Sur

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2016/ra_10749_2016.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Renaming of an Elementary School. – The name of Baybay Elementary School in Barangay San Manuel Sur, Municipality of Agoo, Province of La Union is hereby changed to San Manuel Sur Elementary School.

Location of the Main Campus. – The main campus of the San Manuel Sur Elementary School shall continue to remain in its present location in Barangay San Manuel Sur, Municipality of Agoo, Province of La Union.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
